total_supply_after_constructor.meaning: totalSupply value pre-set by the HypoVault constructor
total_supply_after_constructor.checkpoint: after constructor, before first deposit fulfillment

underlying_assets_after_constructor.meaning: underlying assets owned by the vault after the constructor
underlying_assets_after_constructor.checkpoint: after constructor, before first deposit fulfillment

total_assets_before_first_fulfillment.meaning: totalAssets (computeNAV() == assetsDeposited) observed before the first fulfilment

first_deposit_assets_to_fulfill.meaning: assetsToFulfill of the very first deposit

first_deposit_shares_received.meaning: sharesReceived minted for the very first deposit

later_depositors_shares_worthless.meaning: later depositors buy worthless shares and their funds are effectively stolen
later_depositors_shares_worthless.checkpoint: after first deposit fulfillment, later deposits

assumptions: The first deposit fulfillment is the checked action; its assetsToFulfill and sharesReceived are the intent's operands.
totalAssets == 1 is observed before the first fulfilment as stated.

unresolved.description: The intent's condition 'for the very first deposit' is a scope qualifier, not a Boolean observable; first_deposit_assets_to_fulfill is declared int and cannot serve as a truth condition, so the applicability guard cannot be faithfully encoded with the available grammar.

Report does not give the exact share-mint formula operands beyond the 1-wei denominator and the 1 000-asset / 1 000 000 000-share example, so the relation between sharesReceived and assetsToFulfill is only stated as an equality intent without a numeric derivation.

limitations: Impact is encoded as a grounded Boolean because the report provides no numeric magnitude for the worthless-share outcome.
The P/I/V relationship (constructor pre-set supply and totalAssets == 1 versus the first-deposit equality intent) is left to the post-generation fidelity audit.
